title: Fix the email address check
ask: is_valid_email in emails.py is the check on our newsletter sign-up form. It lets through addresses with spaces, with no dot after the @, and with two @ signs. Please tighten it so the tests in tests/test_emails.py pass.
background: We don't need to be perfect, only to stop the obvious typing mistakes.
About one sign-up in thirty bounces at the moment.
Thandi owns the sign-up form and reviews changes to it.

constraints.text: keep the is_valid_email function to 10 lines or fewer
write a short note on the fix and save it as NOTES.md
put type hints on every argument and the return value of is_valid_email
don't import email_validator, we are not adding a package for this
leave no print( calls in emails.py
don't fetch anything from the web
name Thandi as the reviewer in the notes
